summary.intent: Execute Phase 27 (writable-shares-poc) to implement write permission support for shared folders, including API backend, UI controls, and recipient write actions.
summary.outcome: All 3 plans executed successfully. During human verification, a significant gap was found and fixed: files uploaded to shared folders lacked per-file IPNS records, preventing download/edit. A full shared file read/write path was implemented including save support.

repo: cipher-box-ci-debug is a separate checkout from cipher-box and lacks .env files — they must be copied from the primary cipher-box repo
The web app's API URL defaults to window.location.origin + '/api' when VITE_API_URL is unset, causing it to call port 5173 instead of 3000
Packages must be built in dependency order: core → sdk-core → sdk before the web app can start
The API client (packages/api-client) must be regenerated after controller changes
SharedFileBrowser's TextEditorDialog used the owner's folder update path (useFolder hook) for all saves — there was no shared file save path at all

code.finding: Shared folder uploads set fileMetaIpnsName: '' — per-file IPNS records were never created, making uploaded files unreadable after session
Error 'File metadata IPNS name not available (legacy v1 file?)' thrown when fileMetaIpnsName is empty — surfaced as misleading legacy error for a new PoC limitation
Shared file load path throws if no share_key found — needed fallback to fileKeyEncrypted from file metadata for files uploaded before fix

createFileMetadata called with ownerPublicKey for IPNS key wrapping — recipient can't unwrap IPNS private key, so they can't update the file. Must use recipient's key for IPNS wrapping, owner's key for fileKeyEncrypted
addShareKeys was restricted to share owners only — needed relaxing to allow write-share recipients to add keys to their own share for per-file IPNS records
API URL fallback logic: uses VITE_API_URL env var if set, otherwise defaults to window.location.origin + '/api'

workflow: Background bash tasks in Claude Code get killed when conversation context shifts — use detached processes (nohup or &) for dev servers to survive this
GSD checkpoint verification revealed a real functional gap (missing IPNS records) that automated verification missed — human testing caught what automated checks didn't
Per-file IPNS records created before the fix are unrecoverable — users must delete and re-upload affected files

friction: DB host IP had changed (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12) and no .env existed in the ci-debug checkout — required manual .env creation before API could start
Background dev server tasks were repeatedly killed by conversation context shifts, requiring multiple restarts with different strategies
Web server showed 'disconnected' due to missing VITE_API_URL — defaulting to wrong port with no clear error
SDK and dependency packages needed manual build before web app could start — not documented in ci-debug checkout
Git lock file had to be manually removed before commit could proceed
API client regeneration required after controller changes — easy to forget step
open_items: Files uploaded to shared folders before the IPNS fix have permanently empty fileMetaIpnsName and cannot be recovered — no migration path for legacy broken files

The shared file save path (updateSharedFile) creates a new share_key for the recipient but the approach of wrapping IPNS key with recipient's key means the owner cannot update files uploaded by recipients
30s polling for sync in SharedFileBrowser (plan 27-03) should be reviewed for production — polling interval may need to be configurable
The addShareKeys API relaxation for write-share recipients has no rate limiting or abuse prevention
No automated test coverage for the shared file upload/download/edit cycle — the gap was only caught by human UAT
